newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ICTSI has option for $18.6 mln more debt.
newsitem.headline: ICTSI has option for $18.6 mln more debt.

text.p: Port operator International Container Terminal Services Inc (ICTSI) said on Monday it has an option to issue an additional $18.6 million in convertible notes on top of the $111.4 million it issued recently.
"The offering has a greenshoe option, which allows ICTSI to issue another $18.6 million of new notes up to 12 April 1997," the company said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange.
The seven-year notes carry a coupon of 1.75 percent annually.
The notes can be converted to ICTSI shares at 17.875 pesos per share from June 13, 1997 to March 2, 2004. The notes mature on March 13, 2004. ICTSI closed 25 centavos lower on Monday at 16.50 pesos.
The company had sold $63 million worth of convertible notes to foreign investors, while another $48.4 million were exchanged with the $45.1 million convertible notes it issued in September 1994.
The proceeds will be used to finance domestic expansion projects as well as port investments in Pakistan, the company said.
